content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00306 The RTE shall be implemented in a way that the mappings resulting from [SWS_Rte_80006] and [SWS_Rte_80131] shall not have any effect on the AUTOSAR RTE code, specifically Rte.c, as they might cause unintended replacements there. In particular this means that they shall not change the C symbol of the global copies.
